Drone Tech News

The latest developments in drone technology, curated every week.

13 November 2026Commercial UAV News

US ag-drone distributor Agri Spray pivots to building fully domestic spray drones amid supply-chain rules

Facing US restrictions on Chinese-made drones and components, Missouri-based Agri Spray plans to stop distributing foreign products and become a manufacturer of fully US-sourced agricultural spray drones within five years, starting with in-house software and firmware.

#industry#supply-chain#agriculture

11 November 2026European Commission – DG MOVE

EU Drone Summit sets the course for a secure European drone market and a Trusted Drone Label

More than 400 industry and government participants met in Brussels to review the EU Drone Strategy 2.0. The first findings of the European Trusted Drone Label pilot were published, and an implementation roadmap is due in 2027.

#regulation#europe

11 November 2026Gremsy

Gremsy opens pre-orders for KESTREL, a sub-300 g EO/IR gimbal payload for small UAVs

Gimbal maker Gremsy has opened global pre-orders for KESTREL, an NDAA-compliant dual daylight/thermal payload under 300 g with 640×512 thermal imaging and up to 40x hybrid zoom, aimed at small-UAV manufacturers and integrators.

#thermal#payload#components

11 November 2026Robotics & Automation News

Zipline uses real-time sound modelling to cut drone noise exposure by 68% across its fleet

Zipline's delivery drones now plan their hover-to-wing transitions using live wind data and an onboard sound model. The company reports 68% less sound exposure per flight, 24% lower peak volume and 21% less energy per flight versus its 2025 fleet.

#autonomy#delivery#software

10 November 2026DroneDJ

Skydio ships Controller 2 with a 2,000-nit screen, swappable 5G SIM and encrypted link

Skydio's new handheld ground station for the X10, X10D and R10 adds a 7-inch sunlight-readable display, bring-your-own-plan 5G connectivity, IP55 sealing, AES-256 link encryption and almost six hours of runtime.

#video-transmission#ground-control#enterprise

9 November 2026Aerospace America (AIAA)

DARPA EVADE: flight tests continue for Sikorsky's Nomad long-endurance VTOL drone

Sikorsky's flying-wing Nomad prototype is one of the designs flying under DARPA's $47M EVADE programme, which seeks uncrewed VTOL aircraft with fixed-wing endurance.

#industry#research#vtol

9 November 2026Federal Aviation Administration (FAA)

FAA grants first-of-its-kind authorization for long-range drone flights from the US coast to offshore platforms

The US regulator authorized an autonomous VTOL drone to fly beyond visual line of sight from Louisiana to an offshore energy platform, including a pipeline inspection and a simulated equipment delivery.

#regulation#bvlos#inspection

9 November 2026Skyways newsroom

Skyways launches Skyreach, a hybrid long-range autonomous cargo VTOL

The new autonomous VTOL combines electric vertical flight with fuel-powered cruise for over 1,300 miles of range and 18+ hours of endurance, with a modular bay for cargo, sensors or communications.

#industry#logistics#autonomy

5 November 2026DRONELIFE

DJI Matrice 5T brings native 1280×1024 thermal imaging to compact enterprise drones

The new IP55 enterprise drone pairs a native 1K thermal camera with enhanced night vision, LiDAR and mmWave radar obstacle sensing, onboard AI and up to 59 minutes of flight time.

#thermal#enterprise#night-vision

3 November 2026ETH Zurich News

ETH Zurich's FlexiQuad: a soft-frame drone that keeps flying after collisions

Researchers built a quadrotor with a deformable frame that absorbs impacts yet reaches 80 km/h, opening the door to inspection and rescue flights in tight, cluttered spaces.

#research#fpv#inspection
